normal.name: Emily St. James
normal.text: The main thing I can see as a difference is the level of detail that goes into modeling the world, but even that has diminishing returns. Can I tell there's a LOT more detail in Red Dead Redemption 2 compared to Stardew Valley? Yes. Do both games still have lots of gaps for my brain to fill in? Yep.

normal.name: Tav (Taylor's Version) 🌙✨
normal.text: Since everything is falling apart, let’s plan our solar punk future together. I would gather physical media and would open up a library for everyone because I love books, music, games etc but because of the chronic pain I wouldn’t be helpful for farming etc. What would be your idea?

normal.name: Becca Petunia 🏳️‍⚧️
normal.text: Not to say that there aren't a lot of mediocre cozy games now too. But ACNH is very NON predatory, and I'd love for more games to imitate THAT aspect.

heated.text: Folks like Miley Cyrus understand this country better than most. Waiting around for politicians to put the people first, take good care of the vulnerable, and provide comfort... not going to happen. Politics is a game of self-interests. DO YOU HEAR THAT ELON MUSK? MILEY GETS IT.

heated.name: Puck the Puddle Pilot
heated.text: Dunno man. Stardew completely rebooted a VERY dead genre. The prevalence of AI generated mechanics makes me hopeful for love letter homages to dead games and genres.
